landing.headline: Two signatures on every gram.
landing.subheadline: Weighed by the scale. Heard in his language. Signed by both. Tola replaces disputed paper chits between jewellers and karigars with a dual-signed, voice-first milligram ledger and verifiable Karigar Credit Passport.
landing.builtWith: Voice by Sarvam AI · Agents by Lyzr · Integer ledger-core
landing.howTitle: Three steps. Two people. One record.
landing.step01Body: Weight comes from the balance, never a keyboard. The karigar hears the read-back in Bengali and taps হ্যাঁ to co-sign.
landing.step02Body: Piece, scrap and dust are weighed separately. Deterministic integer code checks wastage against agreed norms; AI explains any flag.
landing.step03Body: Disputes stay visible and resolve with two signatures. Every sealed week builds a portable, revocable Work Passport for the karigar.
